subject: SHELL-005 reads no dialect signal from 20 of 90 judged boxes — unjudged, not clean
description: Chris blocked the first SHELL-005 for reporting these identically to boxes that were genuinely checked. The aggregate looks healthy (2044 commands invoked, 911 classified) while 20 boxes classify ZERO: iot001-005, nt012-016, perf001-005, sec006-010 -- all promptStyle 'linux', 9-14 commands each. Their overrides emit invented domain prose (nac-scan and friends) that matches no shell marker in either family, so SHELL-005 has no opinion about them at all. Sampling three suggests this is benign rather than a hidden defect, but that is a sample, not a derivation -- exactly the kind of 'probably fine' that was said about resetLab. They now raise SHELL-005-NOSIGNAL (LOW, non-blocking) plus a per-run summary line, so the blindness is visible on every run instead of needing an ad-hoc audit to find. NEEDS: decide whether to extend the markers to cover these boxes' idiom, invoke handlers with arguments so error paths are exercised (limitation 2 in the file header), or accept them as permanently out of SHELL-005's reach and say so. Verified independently 2026-09-13: 90 judged, 20 blind, counts reproduce against the gate's own.
